title: Viridis
description: Viridis — a lightweight 16x PvP pack that keeps Minecraft looking exactly like Minecraft. Just the competitive edits: fullbright, clearer fire, cleaner weapons, less visual noise. Vanilla feel.
body:
# Viridis

Viridis is a lightweight 16x PvP pack that keeps Minecraft looking like Minecraft. No restyle, no HD overhaul, no trying to reinvent the game you already know — just the competitive edits that make a fight easier to read, layered on top of the vanilla look you're used to.

Most PvP packs rebuild the whole game and tank your frames doing it. Viridis does the opposite. It leaves the world exactly how it should look and only touches the few things that actually matter when the fight starts, so it stays clean, familiar, and light enough to main.

## What it changes

- **Fullbright** — see in caves, nights, and dark corners without turning your gamma into a setting
- **Clear / low fire** — fire overlay reduced so being lit doesn't blind you
- **Clear pumpkin** — pumpkin-head overlay cleaned for pumpkin PvP
- **Reduced enchant glint** — gear stays readable instead of a purple smear
- **Cleaned weapon models** — swords, mace, bow & crossbow (all pull stages), shield, wind charge, end crystal, and spear, trimmed so they don't eat your screen
- **Custom trident riptide** — reworked riptide visual
- **Edited combat particles** — crits, explosions, smoke and gust tuned for clarity
- **Custom totem**
- **Smaller utilities**

## Why use it

- **16x & vanilla-faithful** — nothing looks out of place
- **Extremely light** — built to cost you zero frames
- A pack you leave on. It doesn't change the game, it just sharpens it.

Made for 1.21.11.

**Happy to hear feedback or suggestions on my discord: NatureBanana**
